title: Global Feasibility Lead II
description:
Job Overview

The Global Feasibility Lead II will play an integral role in operational strategy and planning in the preaward space through participation in strategy development conversations, robust primary and secondary data collection and analysis, and development of feasibility and site selection strategies. In addition, the Global Feasibility Lead II will be responsible for managing global feasibility projects, working closely with representatives within the company to deliver robust feasibility reports to our customers. The Global Feasibility Lead II will transition the site selection strategy to operations in the post-award space by handing over relevant pre-award findings to the site selection team. The Global Feasibility Lead II will lead and/or contribute to process improvement and change initiatives within Feasibility, alongside training opportunities for departmental requirements and any other subjects that impact on feasibility conduct. The Global Feasibility Lead 2 role requires a diverse skill set; strong data mining and analytics skills, writing and presentation skills, and customer management skills are required. Comfort with participating in and/or leading client facing interactions as it relates to presenting feasibility related findings and recommendations is necessary.


Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Accountable for supporting the development, analyses, interpretation, and presentation of primary and secondary data in support of operational strategy and planning.
  • Conducts data mining of internal and external databases and initiates/oversees the collection of primary data for use in development of robust strategies for global clinical trials (country/site mix, site selection, enrollment modeling.).
  • Participates in the development of proposals and bid defenses; provides recommendations on the most appropriate use of data to support proposals and bid defense presentations, works with the team to identify potential risks, and is learning to propose effective solutions as appropriate.
  • Actively participates on cross-functional teams that plan, analyze, and present proposals and bid defenses as part of winning new business and maintaining client base.
  • Serves as functional bidder reviewer of the budget and text for proposals for which feasibility and/or site identification is included as the primary deliverable.
  • Leads cross functional teams in standalone feasibility efforts; responsible for final report creation and delivery, including discussion of findings and recommendations with external clients.
  • Participates in intra and inter-departmental meetings, leading/contributing to the presentation of information on feasibility offerings, demonstrating continued value-add of the department and providing training on best practices, processes and tools.
  • Develops networking abilities and has an ability/willingness to work with individuals across the globe.
  • Leads and/or contributes to process improvement or special projects within Feasibility.
  • Lead and/or contributes to development, implementation, and maintenance of systems within Feasibility.
  • Contributes to best practice for feasibility conduct.
  • Mentors junior team members (GFL1 or newer GFL2s as needed)
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.


Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • Associate degree with equivalent work experience.
  • Practical experience and understanding of global drug development and clinical trials including demonstrated experience for the mining, manipulating, and presenting of complex scientific data as it relates to clinical research and market analyses.


Experience (Minimum Required)

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation , and AI/LLM Quality Assurance . The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations , and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience in AI red teaming , LLM safety testing, or adversarial prompt design.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering , NLP tasks, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
  • Strong background in Quality Assurance , content review, or test case development for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.
  • Experience in risk assessment, red team security testing, or AI policy & governance.

Background in linguistics, psychology, or computational ethics is a plus.

  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models; design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts; replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code; optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed; measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week; decreased cycle time; reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.g., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ; Postgres/Redis; REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends; write clean, testable code; and deploy via CI/CD to a major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics; you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity; you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.g., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.g., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.io/Cloudflare + Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful; evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

title: Staff Accountant (Netsuite)
description:
SUMMARY


INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. This role plays a key part in supporting Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on experience with NetSuite, and enjoys working in a structured, process-driven environment. This position is responsible for data entry, testing, reconciliations, and configuration validation within the NetSuite system.


PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES


NetSuite Accounting Data Management


  • Enter and validate accounting-related data in NetSuite.
  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of all accounting entries in NetSuite across AR, AP, GL, and Payroll modules.
  • Conduct regular audits to identify and correct data inconsistencies or configuration issues.
  • Support daily transactional entry, adjustments, and posting of journal entries under supervision.


Testing & System Validation


  • Assist in testing accounting processes across NetSuite modules:
  • Validate system workflows for AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, and Payroll.
  • Perform UAT (User Acceptance Testing) during NetSuite updates or enhancements.
  • Work closely with the Accounting, Finance, and IT teams to identify and troubleshoot accounting-related system errors or configuration gaps.
  • Help document testing procedures and results for audit and compliance purposes.


Month-End & Operational Support


  • Support the month-end close process by preparing, verifying, and entering journal entries in NetSuite.
  • Assist in reconciling general ledger accounts and running reports to support financial review.
  • Ensure system data is closed and locked appropriately in accordance with internal deadlines.


Documentation & Internal Support


  • Maintain accurate documentation of system processes, data input standards, and workflows within NetSuite.
  • Assist accounting team members in navigating NetSuite functionality and resolving data entry issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of NetSuite accounting procedures and controls.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


KEY COMPETENCIES


  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite ERP and accounting module navigation.
  • Understanding of US GAAP accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative accounting team.
  • Capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting data manipulation.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of accounting experience, with 2+ years of hands-on strong experience in NetSuite ERP.
  • Solid understanding of general accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
  • Experience working with accounting data across modules like AR, AP, GL, and Payroll.


WHAT WE OFFER


  • Remote work opportunity.
  • Working hours 8-5 EST (preferred).
  • Monthly gross salary within the range of $1000-$2200.
  • Participating in our "One Window - One Tree" initiative.
  • The opportunity to improve your skills through professional development training.
  • A rapidly growing company.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Java com experiência comprovada em liderança de times técnicos. Procuramos alguém com sólida bagagem em desenvolvimento backend, que conheça os desafios de ambientes de alta performance e que tenha atuado como referência técnica e gestora de equipe.

O(a) profissional ideal sabe equilibrar o desenvolvimento de código com a gestão do time, promovendo boas práticas, apoiando o time e garantindo a qualidade técnica das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir a qualidade, escalabilidade e performance das soluções.
  • Apoiar o time na tomada de decisões técnicas e resolução de problemas.
  • Realizar code reviews e propor melhorias técnicas contínuas.
  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de soluções (mão na massa).
  • Conduzir ritos ágeis e colaborar com áreas parceiras.
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar o desempenho do time (1:1, feedbacks, planos de desenvolvimento).
  • Estimular boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Acompanhar prazos de entrega de melhorias e correções de bugs, garantindo previsibilidade e alinhamento.
  • Acompanhar tendências e propor soluções com uso de Inteligência Artificial, especialmente voltadas à automação, ganho de produtividade e melhoria de processos.


Requisitos obrigatórios:


  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead Java.
  • Sólida experiência com Java 8 ou superior (utilizamos Java 21), além de Spring Boot e Spring MVC.
  • Experiência com Hibernate, JUnit 5, Mockito 2 e Git.
  • Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL).
  • Experiência com Redis.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs.
  • Familiaridade com VueJS, TypeScript e Javascript.
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta concorrência, performance e grandes volumes de dados.
  • Habilidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.



Desejáveis:


  • Experiência com análise de logs e troubleshooting.
  • Otimização de queries e análise de performance.
  • Conhecimento em Kibana/APM.
  • Conhecimento em MongoDB e PL/SQL.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento mobile (Ionic + VueJS).
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas: JSP, AngularJS, jQuery.


Ambiente técnico:


  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Infraestrutura em AWS.
  • Integração contínua com Jenkins, Sonar e Docker.
  • Repositórios no GitHub.
  • IntelliJ Ultimate como IDE.

title: Application Support Engineer – Salesforce & Azure (Specright / PDMS / Interius)
description:
We are seeking an Application Support Engineer to provide end-to-end technical and functional support for two enterprise platforms — Specright / PDMS (Salesforce-based) and Interius (Azure-hosted). This role will be responsible for ensuring smooth daily operations, resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity, and supporting integration enhancements across both systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide Tier 2/3 application support for the Specright PDMS and Interius platforms, managing incidents, service requests, and troubleshooting data and access issues.
  • Maintain and improve integrations between Salesforce-based and Azure-hosted systems; collaborate with middleware teams to configure, test, and monitor API and data connections.
  • Develop, modify, and troubleshoot Salesforce Data Loader scripts for bulk data imports, updates, and migrations.
  • Support supplier onboarding, user administration, and role-based access configuration.
  • Collaborate with business and IT teams to analyze issues, validate solutions, and optimize workflows.
  • Participate in integration testing, documentation of technical specifications, and maintenance of operational playbooks.
  • Liaise with vendor support teams (Salesforce, Specright) for escalated issues and platform enhancements.
  • Monitor system performance, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to continuous process and system optimization.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS application support (Salesforce preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with APIs (REST/SOAP) , authentication (OAuth/SSO), and data integration .
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Loader or similar ETL tools.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure environments and integration workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills; able to work independently in a global environment.
  • Experience supporting packaging, supplier, or product data management systems is a plus.

title: Water & Sanitation Expert
description:
Join Mútua as a Short-Term Expert Reviewer for the Water & Sanitation System Transition in Latin America


Are you a researcher, consultant, or practitioner with deep expertise in the sustainability transitions of Water & Sanitation systems in Latin America?


Mútua is bringing together a select group of qualified experts for a short-term, paid engagement to collectively review the content of our intelligence platform—created to support funders seeking to accelerate the transition toward a more regenerative, equitable, and resilient water & sanitation system in the region.


About the Role


This is a temporary expert engagement, compensated on an hourly basis (with rates to be agreed upon individually). As a contributor, you will help refine and validate the knowledge embedded in our platform, ensuring it accurately reflects strategic priorities, transition pathways, and systemic leverage points relevant to water & sanitation in Latin America.


We are looking for individuals with a systems-informed perspective on:


  • Key transition pathways for equitable and sustainable water & sanitation access
  • Interventions linking water security, public health, livelihoods and climate resilience
  • The role of policy, finance, innovation, and grassroots action in driving transformation


Whether your experience is in integrated water resource management, rural and urban sanitation, water justice, climate-resilient infrastructure, or water governance—your insights will help funders better identify and support transformative initiatives.


About Mútua


Mútua is an AI-powered intelligence platform that connects mission-driven funders—from philanthropic foundations to impact investors—with innovators such as startups, NGOs, and research institutions. We align capital with systemic solutions in critical systems like food, healthcare, and energy.


By transforming fragmented impact data into actionable intelligence, we empower funders to make faster, more strategic, and more impactful decisions.


Who We’re Looking For


We invite applications from Water & Sanitation experts with:


  • Proven knowledge and experience in water & sanitation systems in Latin America
  • A strong grasp of systemic and cross-sectoral dynamics
  • The ability to provide strategic and constructive feedback on frameworks, content, and priorities


Fluency in English is required, as all content to be reviewed is written in English.


This is a remote, flexible opportunity. We welcome applicants based across the Americas and Europe.


If you're committed to shaping the future of food, agriculture, and land in Latin America—and want to contribute to a tool that mobilizes capital for systemic change—we’d love to hear from you.

iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Nosso Cliente

Procuramos por PMO para gerenciar e liderar o roadmap de desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas que suportarão projetos de dados, garantindo a orquestração entre squads, stakeholders e áreas de negócio, com foco em governança, arquitetura, engenharia e produtos de dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Liderança e referência da visão do cliente/negócio, desenvolver o relacionamento com clientes internos e estar pronto para ajudar no desenvolvimento do time;
  • Business-driven, conhecer o dia a dia de áreas de negócio e operações, trabalhando as principais métricas processos e necessidades. Pensar no que o negócio precisa para atingir suas metas e atender o cliente;
  • Disseminar conhecimento com seus pares, documentando, comunicando e viabilizando o acesso às informações;
  • Ter atitude de dono, buscando as melhores práticas na implementação de demandas, processos e tecnologias com foco nos resultados e entregas;
  • Comunicação assertiva e clara, sendo capaz de ser a interface com os principais stakeholders de várias áreas de negócio. Identificar, definir e gerenciar escopos de necessidades de curto, médio e longo prazos;
  • Bom raciocínio lógico, senso crítico, organização e agilidade na resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade, foco e boa capacidade de trabalhar em equipe;
  • Gerenciar projetos e programas relacionados a dados, com múltiplas squads envolvidas e escopo técnico/funcional complexo;
  • Construir e manter planos macro e detalhados de entregas (roadmap, cronograma, marcos), promovendo previsibilidade;
  • Garantir business readiness ao coordenar ações de comunicação, treinamento, documentação e alinhamento com áreas de negócio;
  • Facilitar cerimônias e processos ágeis, como Sprint Planning, Reviews e Retrospectives, quando aplicável ao projeto;
  • Orquestrar dependências técnicas e operacionais, atuando com engenharia de dados, produtos, arquitetura e governança;
  • Estabelecer rituais e cadências de comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos, reportando indicadores e progresso;
  • Inglês (projetos com stakeholders internacionais);
  • Organizar entregáveis finais, como kits de go-live, guias operacionais, planos de suporte e trilhas de capacitação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Roadmap integrado com priorizações, desdobramentos e marcos;
  • Plano de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders (matriz RACI, mapeamento de impacto);
  • Métricas de sucesso do projeto e controle de entregas por squad ou frente;
  • Cronograma de capacitação e readiness (documentação, UAT, suporte de pós-go live);
  • Acompanhamento estruturado por metodologia híbrida (ágil + tradicional);
  • Inglês Intermediário ou Avançado;
  • Planejamento e execução de Sprint 0 e fases Discovery, se aplicável.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.


Regime de Contratação

CLT.


Conhecimentos desejáveis:

  • Governança de dados (DAMA, LGPD, catálogos, data quality, linhagem);
  • Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Metabase;
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos: Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project;
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e tradicionais (PMBOK, PRINCE2);
  • Conhecimento em produtos de dados, data mesh e arquiteturas modernas (data lake, cloud, event-driven);
  • Storytelling com dados: saber transformar indicadores e métricas em narrativas acionáveis;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Telepatia

Telepatia AI is building an AI Doctor to radically improve healthcare. We recently raised the largest LatAm seed round of $9M, backed by top global investors. Our team comes from Stanford, Microsoft, MD Anderson, Houston Methodist, and Alice, and we’re on a mission to transform how clinical data is captured and used.

Healthcare has two fundamental sources of truth: images and conversations. While most technology has focused on images, 99% of real medical decisions are made through voice. Telepatia is capturing that voice data and turning it into structured, reliable clinical intelligence—unlocking the foundation for an AI-first healthcare system.

We are assembling one of the most talent-dense technical teams in Latin America, with the ambition of building the “Manhattan Project” of AI in healthcare.


Mission of the Role

As an AI Engineer at Telepatia , your mission is to design, build, and deploy AI systems that turn unstructured clinical conversations into structured, reliable medical intelligence. You’ll work across the stack—from backend Python microservices and LLM orchestration to lightweight front-ends and data pipelines—integrating the latest in AI research into production workflows used by doctors daily.

You’ll be part of a small, elite team where each engineer’s output directly impacts the accuracy of our AI systems, the speed of our clinical documentation, and ultimately, patient care across Latin America. This is a role for builders who want to ship fast, work with autonomy, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in applied AI.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and scale Python microservices (FastAPI) that handle real-time inference and structured data processing.
  • Build AI agent pipelines for reasoning, orchestration, and multi-step workflows using tools like LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Develop data pipelines and eval dashboards to monitor, analyze, and improve AI model performance.
  • Collaborate closely with clinicians, product managers, and software engineers to turn ambiguous requests into production-ready AI features—often in less than a day.
  • Integrate models and pipelines into our core Medical Scribe product to enhance automation, reliability, and doctor experience.
  • Contribute to key technical decisions around LLM infrastructure, evaluation, scalability, and deployment.


Must-Haves

  • Strong backend experience in Python , with a focus on microservices (FastAPI preferred).
  • Experience building at the AI application layer : LLM orchestration, agents, and pipelines (LangChain, CrewAI, or similar).
  • Frontend familiarity with React/Tailwind or Flutter for rapid prototyping and data visualization.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and evaluation dashboards for AI models.
  • High product velocity: you prioritize shipping value quickly over theoretical perfection.
  • Ability to take ambiguous, non-technical requests and turn them into working production features in less than a day.
  • Strong ownership mindset, curiosity, and comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in hard sciences such as Physics or Mathematics .
  • Experience with vector databases , RAG architectures , or model evaluation frameworks .
  • Prior work with healthcare data , EHR systems , or HIPAA/LGPD compliance.
  • Prior startup experience in high-growth or early-stage environments.

Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.

  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;

  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.

title: Senior Infrastructure Linux Engineer (L2 | Production | Market Data | Remote | Brazil)
description:
IMPORTANT: Eligible location is Brazil


Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Role Description


We are looking for a skilled Senior Linux infrastructure engineer to maintain and enhance the real-time data systems powering one of the world’s leading investment banks as our customer. You will handle alert and incident management, problem resolution, and system improvements, ensuring uptime and performance for global trading and data services.managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues.
  • Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements.
  • Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues.
  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in infrastructure, systems, or production support roles
  • Highly skilled in Linux System Administration
  • Experience in Windows operating systems
  • Scripting proficiency (Bash and/or Python preferred)
  • Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.
  • Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must
  • Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices
  • Prior experience in banking, investment, or other financial IT environments is advantageous
  • Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with ITRS Geneos , EXEGY (Wombat/Vela) , or Market Data platforms (Refinitiv TREP/RTDS, Bloomberg)
  • Familiarity with AWS ECS , AWS VPC , Google Cloud
  • Experience with GitHub/GitLab and automation pipelines


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits packagr
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: SAP Technical Cutover Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Technical Cutover Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


'Key Responsibilities

Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4HANA cutover best practices and standards.

Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure DevOps (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.

Prior hands-on experience with SAP configuration, development, implementation troubleshooting and resolution of technical defects is required for this Technical Cutover Manager to manage all technical activities of other technical cutover resources.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Skills

Experience with prior projects with a successful cutover to go-live with SAP S/4HANA.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid waterfall and Agile project methodologies.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Closer - Vendas Internacionais (Inglês Fluente)
description:
Vaga: Closer – Vendas Internacionais (Inglês Fluente)


Modalidade: 100% Home Office

Contratação: PJ – MEI ativo obrigatório

Localização: Aberta para todo o Brasil


Descrição da Função

Estamos construindo uma operação comercial internacional focada em fechar vendas em inglês para agências e empreendedores brasileiros que estão expandindo seus negócios para os Estados Unidos

Buscamos um Closer com inglês fluente, perfil comunicativo e mentalidade de crescimento, para conduzir calls de fechamento com leads qualificados, aplicar playbooks de vendas já estruturados e manter o CRM sempre atualizado.

É uma oportunidade real para quem quer entrar no mercado internacional, ganhar em dólar e crescer dentro de uma operação que já possui leads, processos e suporte prontos.

Não precisa ser um closer sênior, o essencial é saber se comunicar, ter disciplina e fome de resultado.


O que você vai fazer


Você será responsável por todas as calls e etapas do funil de vendas operacional, com apoio pontual quando necessário:

  • Confirmar calls e reduzir no-shows (Inbound)
  • Conduzir closer calls em inglês (fechamentos de alto ticket)
  • Executar follow-ups e reativações de leads
  • Comunicar-se com agências/clientes (feedbacks e alinhamentos)
  • Gerir agenda de forma organizada (Google Agenda / Notion Calendar / Calendly) — bloqueando horários quando indisponível e liberando quando houver espaço
  • Ser proativo: trazer ideias, resolver problemas e agir sem depender de supervisão constante


Meta mínima: tocar 4 vendas por dia, garantindo consistência e resultado. (Se conseguir mais, melhor, a autonomia é sua.)


Perfil que eu procuro

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with at least 5 years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with GraphQL.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. Desired Experience

title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)
description:
Location: On-Site position based in the UAE (Full Relocation Package)


A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

description:

At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.

We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . Required Qualifications

  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.

title: Financial Analyst, Acquisitions
description:
Company

Homestead Communities (the “Company”) addresses the affordable housing crisis in the United States by providing safe, clean and supportive communities where working families and retirees can own or rent affordable, high-quality, single-family manufactured homes.  Founded in 2023, the Company was one of the ten largest buyers of manufactured housing communities (“MHC”) over the past two years. Homestead Communities is committed to responsible stewardship for its residents, providing engaging careers for its team members, and delivering attractive risk-adjusted returns to its investor. 

Homestead Communities is owned by its management team and one of the world’s largest, publicly-traded, international real estate investors. The Company combines proven, growth-orientated entrepreneurial leadership with institutional discipline and financial capability. This position offers the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a new enterprise with proven partners and the resources and experience to build a significant operating business.

Location

Anywhere in Brasil, (or Latin America).  The position is home-based.


Position Overview

The Financial Analyst, Acquisitions will use the Company’s financial model to project cash flows for potential acquisitions. Projections include initial capital, financing, and monthly operating income and expenses. Projections depend on analysis of MHC’s historic financial statements, current rent roll, and primary market research, all lead by the Financial Analyst, Acquisitions.  Further financial analysis, which may require additional market or property diligence, is typically needed to respond to property-specific questions and unique investment characteristics.

The position can be full-time or a minimum commitment of 25 hours weekly. If part-time, the candidate must have flexibility to meet carrying deadlines for workflow. The daily time commitment will vary with the Company’s deal flow. There will be times when there are multiple transactions at the same time and times when there are short deadlines.  There will be times between transactions that the Financial Analyst, Acquisitions will assist in broader work related to acquisitions.

Responsibilities

·        Prepare cash flow projections for proposed acquisitions.

o   Detailed, monthly projections for ten-year hold period. Dozens of line-items used to specify assumptions and clearly calculate resulting values.

o   The Vice President, Acquisitions provides initial underwriting assumptions, sets deadlines, and provides quality assurance review. 

o   Review and understand historic financial statements from a MHC seller and/or broker.

o   Prepare return sensitivities to varying operating assumptions.

·        Research the competitive housing market of potential MHC acquisitions.

o   Identify comparable MHCs and call MHCs to determine their occupancy, rental rates, amenities, and housing stock.

o   Review rental rates for competitive apartments and single-family homes. Review sales values and absorption of for-sale single-family homes in the submarket.

·        Prepare Investment Committee memoranda summarizing the potential investment.

·        Supervise updates to various proprietary databases used in the acquisitions workflow.

o   Master MHC property and owner lists.

o   CRM lists and programs.

o   MHC sales comps through database searches and contact with MHC brokers.

·        Track trends in AI and SaaS tools that could further automate the Company’s acquisition process.


Reporting

·        Reports to and will be supported by our Vice President, Acquisitions. 

·       Consults with senior team members to refine operating assumptions (operating and capital expenses).


Advancement

·        The candidate will get broad exposure to the acquisition, management and ownership of MHCs. 

·   Broader financial analysis and coding opportunities exist if they fit the experience and interest of the candidate.

·        Further opportunities may include broader responsibilities sourcing and supporting acquisitions.

Qualifications

·        Expert in Microsoft Excel and comfortable with basic math functions. (Calculus is useless.)  Thorough understanding of income statements and balance sheets.

·        Work experience at minimum in summer internships in residential or commercial real estate brokerage, lending, investment or consulting; private equity; investment banking; or accounting. One or two years of full-time employment is desirable but not required. More familiarity with residential real estate is preferred.

·        Fluent in English.

Compensation

·        Annual salary highly competitive for the location and qualifications of the candidate.

·        Annual cash bonus target of 10% of total annual salary depending on the achievement of mutually-agreed goals.  

·        Paid time off, (“PTO”), at the candidate’s discretion, if full time. Three weeks of PTO if the candidate is part-time.

·        For candidates in the United States, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability and life insurance. 

·        For candidates in the United States, 401(k) with Company matching employee’s contributions up to 4% of employee’s compensation. Compensation will be increased for candidates who cannot take advantage of the 401(k) program.


Miscellaneous

·        Occasional, (two or three times annually), travel for Company events. Initial training in Dallas, Texas.

title: Data Architect
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Architect will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data models and SQL-based solutions, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform. This role will ensure data integrity, optimize database performance, and support data-driven initiatives, particularly within the higher education sector.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Modelling and SQL Development

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient relational and dimensional data models.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity across various data sources and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.


Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Power BI Developer
description:
Company Overview

Our client is a leading Project Portfolio Management (PPM) software company helping organizations deliver complex projects with speed and precision. As part of their growth, they seek a skilled Power BI Developer to join their product and engineering teams, driving our reporting and analytics capabilities to the next level.


Role Overview

You will be the primary Power BI authority, embedded within the product team and reporting directly to the Head of Product. Unlike legacy reporting roles, this position demands holistic thinking at the data model level, structuring interlinked datasets, and designing reports that deliver insight and impact. You will bring both technical rigor and visual finesse, turning raw data into compelling stories that support better decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain sophisticated Power BI dashboards and reports tailored to customer needs, reflecting strong narrative design principles.
  • Develop and manage embedded Power BI analytics solutions within our proprietary PPM software platform.
  • Architect and implement semantic data models in Power BI, integrating with Databricks and ensuring logical taxonomy for all datasets.
  • Write advanced PowerQuery scripts and DAX calculations for complex data transformation and analytics scenarios as needed.
  • Conduct thorough data QA, validating key metrics between our PPM platform, Databricks, and Power BI outputs.
  • Leverage SQL to extract, transform, and validate data. Understanding our integrations between Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Azure Databricks, and Power BI.
  • Optimize dashboard performance with a deep understanding of Import mode vs. Direct Query trade‑offs.
  • Power BI workspace management, external user access, and governance best practices for secure reporting.
  • Collaborate in an Azure cloud environment with engineers and architects to ensure smooth data delivery pipelines.


Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Proven ability to blend technical data modeling expertise with sharp visual storytelling instincts.
  • Experience in PPM or project management software reporting environments.
  • Familiarity with Databricks Delta Sharing and cross‑organization data collaboration.
  • Success in working independently with minimal supervision in high‑autonomy roles.
  • Strong cross‑functional communication skills, fluent in English.
  • Previous experience collaborating with remote/offshore technical teams.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Power BI, including PowerQuery, DAX, and semantic modeling.
  • 2+ years of experience building Embedded Power BI Analytics solutions and managing advanced workspace functionality.
  • Proficient in SQL and comfortable moving data across cloud platforms (OCI, Databricks, Azure).
  • Demonstrated success in conducting data QA and optimizing report performance.
  • Solid understanding of Import mode, Direct Query, workspace management, and governance protocols in Power BI.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo:

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.


Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.


Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.


Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.


Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.


O que fazemos:

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de  R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.


Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas/bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.


Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.


Prêmios e reconhecimentos: 

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S/A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.


Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas


Local de trabalho: 

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.


Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ


Requisitos mínimos:

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.


O que valorizamos:

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e/ou carteira de clientes ativa.


—


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.


Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)

title: Mobility & Logistics Expert
description:
Join Mútua as a Short-Term Expert Reviewer for the Mobility & Logistics System Transition in Latin America


Are you a researcher, consultant, or practitioner with deep expertise in the sustainability transitions of Mobility & Logistics systems in Latin America?


Mútua is bringing together a select group of qualified experts for a short-term, paid engagement to collectively review the content of our intelligence platform—created to support funders seeking to accelerate the transition toward a more regenerative, equitable, and resilient Mobility & Logistics system in the region.


About the Role


This is a temporary expert engagement, compensated on an hourly basis (with rates to be agreed upon individually). As a contributor, you will help refine and validate the knowledge embedded in our platform, ensuring it accurately reflects strategic priorities, transition pathways, and systemic leverage points relevant to Mobility & Logistics in Latin America.


We are looking for individuals with a systems-informed perspective on:


  • Key transition pathways for equitable and sustainable mobility & logistics access
  • Interventions linking transportation access, economic opportunity, public health and climate resilience
  • The role of policy, finance, innovation, and grassroots action in driving transformation


Whether your experience is in sustainable urban mobility, freight and supply chain logistics, transport equity, climate-resilient infrastructure, or mobility governance—your insights will help funders better identify and support transformative initiatives.


About Mútua


Mútua is an AI-powered intelligence platform that connects mission-driven funders—from philanthropic foundations to impact investors—with innovators such as startups, NGOs, and research institutions. We align capital with systemic solutions in critical systems like food, healthcare, and energy.


By transforming fragmented impact data into actionable intelligence, we empower funders to make faster, more strategic, and more impactful decisions.


Who We’re Looking For


We invite applications from Mobility & Logistics experts with:


  • Proven knowledge and experience in mobility & logistics systems in Latin America
  • A strong grasp of systemic and cross-sectoral dynamics
  • The ability to provide strategic and constructive feedback on frameworks, content, and priorities


Fluency in English is required, as all content to be reviewed is written in English.


This is a remote, flexible opportunity. We welcome applicants based across the Americas and Europe.


If you're committed to shaping the future of food, agriculture, and land in Latin America—and want to contribute to a tool that mobilizes capital for systemic change—we’d love to hear from you.
